# Block 1 at 0x644ba9
00644ba9  b8 18 dc 81 00   mov     eax, 0x81dc18  ; __thiscall(incoming, controlBlock, releaseControlBlock). Depth-ordered insert of a child into THIS type-2 subcomponent's own child list at this+0x88 (element count via StdDequePtr_GetElementCount_Type2ChildList over this+0x98 / this+0x88).

This is the nested counterpart of CMapSceneryComponent_ReorderSubcomponentForDepth (0x635AE6):
same depth rule, but over a type-2 entry's children instead of the map's active deque. It is what
0x635AE6 tail-calls once CMapSceneryType2Subcomponent_FootprintContainsTile says the incoming
falls inside this entry's footprint.

Structure (0x644BF7..0x644CC4): linear scan i over the child list. Per child:
  incoming->vtable[0x14]() -> (inA, inB)      [inA = eax_1, inB = var_2c]
  child->vtable[0x14]()    -> (enA, enB)      [enA = edi,   enB = var_34]
  CGameMap_GetType3SubcomponentDepthSpanOrDefault -> child span (var_48, var_44)
                                                    incoming span (var_40, var_3c)
Then the ordering decision, which this function states far more plainly than 0x635AE6 does:

  0x644C73  axis-A overlap := !((inA - spanA_in - enA + 1) > 0 || (enA - spanA_en - inA + 1) > 0)
  0x644C78    on A overlap:  insert here iff inB < enB
  0x644C90  axis-B overlap := !((inB - spanB_in - enB + 1) > 0 || (enB - spanB_en - inB + 1) > 0)
  0x644C94    on B overlap:  insert here iff inA < enA
  0x644CA5  NEITHER axis overlaps: insert here iff (inA + inB) < (enA + enB)

The third case is the one 0x635AE6 only hinted at through its (a + b) sum comparisons in the
forward/backward scans. Full comparator, "does incoming draw before child":

  if      (overlapA) return inB < enB;
  else if (overlapB) return inA < enA;
  else               return (inA + inB) < (enA + enB);

Insert goes through sub_641F2F at the scanned position; running off the end appends via
CMapType3Component_AppendType11SubcomponentPointer (0x644CD0). Shared-pointer strong references
on the child are taken with SharedPtr_AssignControlBlockAndIncrementStrongReference and released
on every exit path.
